envFrom.description:
env, ports, probes and resources are derived from the hub/edge roles;
probes keys set here win, down to single spec fields.
App config (DB DSN, public URLs, OIDC, OTEL) merges in here as a map:
env:
  TOWONEL_HUB_DB_DRIVER: postgres

securityContext.description:
Container securityContext (read-only root filesystem, drops ALL
capabilities, keeps NET_BIND_SERVICE for privileged listeners).
allowPrivilegeEscalation is dropped automatically when the edge is
enabled — NoNewPrivs would block the file-cap bind of 443/80.
securityContext.title: securityContext

replicas.description:
type and strategy are derived from the hub/edge roles by _config.tpl.
Replicas (Deployment only; only one hub replica is the active leader).

defaultPodOptions.description:

securityContext.description:
Pod-level securityContext: non-root uid/gid 10001. The edge binds its
privileged host ports (443/80) as this non-root user via the binary's file
capabilities, so it never runs as root.

kind.description:
Workload kind: deployment or daemonset. Empty picks the role default
(daemonset when the edge is enabled, deployment otherwise).
kind.title: kind

strategy.description:
Deployment update strategy (hub-only). Empty defaults to Recreate, because
the hub is active/passive: a surged pod only passes /v1/readyz once it wins
the Postgres advisory lock the old leader holds, so the old pod must
terminate first. RollingUpdate (maxUnavailable:0) would deadlock the rollout.
strategy.title: strategy
